{"reply": "Thank you, Jeffrey. You're verified. I need to correct my last message: your Halden went into service on 2021-01-23, not 2023. Here are the facts I found for your 2021 Halden (123,809 km).

Warranty:
- Basic coverage (3 years / 60,000 km) is no longer within its limits.
- Powertrain coverage (5 years / 100,000 km) is no longer within its limits.
- Corrosion coverage (7 years) is still within its limits. It excludes surface rust and stone chips.

I can't tell you whether this warning is covered. Only the warranty desk decides that, after an inspection, so I can't promise you won't pay.

Open recall NM-24R01: "Rear camera image may not display." The fix is a software update of about 45 minutes. Parts are available. Recall repairs are free for you. I can't say if this recall is linked to your dash warning.

Would you like me to send a warranty review request to the warranty desk for the flashing yellow warning light? It would be a request only, not an approval.", "action": "asked_clarification", "escalation_reason": "none", "summary": "", "policy_rules_cited": ["P-01", "P-03", "P-04"]}
